platform_mcp_otto_retail_media_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_OTTO_RETAIL_MEDIA_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_otto_retail_media_client_id.description: Client ID of a self-app created in OTTO Partner Connect > API-Zugriff with the advertising-services scope (https://api.otto.market/docs/sellers-integration).

platform_mcp_otto_retail_media_client_se.title: PLATFORM_MCP_OTTO_RETAIL_MEDIA_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_otto_retail_media_client_se.description: The app's client secret (shown once in OPC). Tokens last 1800 s and are re-minted with the client credentials (no refresh token).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v1/sponsored-product-ads/campaigns?limit=1: confirms the client credentials and the advertising-services scope (the partner is derived from the token).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /v1/sponsored-product-ads/campaigns (the token's partner; account_id is not sent, `status` is not a filter). `budget` is budget.amount in EUR for the period in raw.budgetType (DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY or LIFETIME). Cursor paging: only the first page is returned.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: PATCH /v1/sponsored-product-ads/campaigns/{id} (application/merge-patch+json) {budget: {amount, currency: EUR}}: a whole-euro amount (minimum 20) applied to the campaign's existing budgetType, which cannot be changed, so it is a daily budget only for DAILY campaigns; spends money. The write is asynchronous: 202 returns a changeRequest (status PENDING) to poll at /v1/sponsored-product-ads/change-requests/{request_id}; only one pending change per campaign (409 otherwise).

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: PATCH /v1/sponsored-product-ads/campaigns/{id} {status: PAUSED|ACTIVE} (only ACTIVE or PAUSED campaigns). Asynchronous: the returned changeRequest status is PENDING until OTTO accepts it. Resuming restarts spending.
